Hello Ellery Projects team,

I'm Janani, and I build websites for builders and promoters in Chennai. I was looking at elleryprojects.com this week. On a phone, the first thing people see on your site is a black block of phone numbers and email addresses, and your building photos only start halfway down the screen. Most home buyers look up builders on their phone, so that first screen matters.

So I rebuilt it, using your own photos and details. Here's how it looks today and how it could look, on a computer and on a phone:

Why this matters now: AI search. More and more people skip Google and simply ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Google's AI answers for “a builder in Guduvanchery in Guduvanchery”. These assistants recommend the businesses whose websites clearly tell them who you are, where you are and what you offer. Right now elleryprojects.com has a few of the basics, but not the full set these tools look for. Your new website is built for it: your details are written in the standard format AI tools read (schema.org), it has a clear question-and-answer section, and an llms.txt file made for AI assistants.

  • Call and WhatsApp buttons on every screen
  • Basic Google setup, so home buyers searching for flats in Guduvanchery in Guduvanchery can find you
  • Two rounds of changes: new photos, prices, wording, anything you like
